import Mathlib

def seq_u64_to_int (xs : List Nat) : List Nat := xs

def is_valid_robbery (houses : List Nat) (len : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, i < houses.length → houses.getD i 0 < len) ∧
  (∀ i, i < houses.length - 1 → houses.getD (i+1) 0 ≥ houses.getD i 0 + 2)

def total_loot (houses : List Nat) (values : List Nat) : Nat :=
  houses.foldl (fun acc i => acc + values.getD i 0) 0

-- Precondition definition
@[simp, reducible]
def rob_precond (nums : List Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  nums.length ≤ 100 ∧
  ∀ i, i < nums.length → nums.getD i 0 ≤ 10000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def robList : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | [x] => x
  | x :: y :: rest => max (x + robList rest) (robList (y :: rest))

def robSet : List Nat → List Nat
  | [] => []
  | [_] => [0]
  | x :: y :: rest =>
      if robList (y :: rest) ≤ x + robList rest then
        0 :: (robSet rest).map (· + 2)
      else
        (robSet (y :: rest)).map (· + 1)

inductive NonAdj : List Nat → Prop
  | nil : NonAdj []
  | one (a : Nat) : NonAdj [a]
  | cons (a b : Nat) (t : List Nat) (h : a + 2 ≤ b) (ht : NonAdj (b :: t)) :
      NonAdj (a :: b :: t)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function (dynamic programming solution)
def rob (nums : List Nat) (h_precond : rob_precond nums) : Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  robList nums
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definition
@[simp, reducible]
def rob_postcond (nums : List Nat) (result : Nat) (h_precond : rob_precond nums) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ houses : List Nat,
      is_valid_robbery houses nums.length →
        total_loot houses (seq_u64_to_int nums) ≤ result) ∧
    (∃ houses : List Nat,
        is_valid_robbery houses nums.length ∧
          total_loot houses (seq_u64_to_int nums) = result)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
@[simp] lemma getD_cons_zero' (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) : (a :: l).getD 0 0 = a := by
  simp [List.getD]

@[simp] lemma getD_cons_succ' (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) (i : Nat) :
    (a :: l).getD (i + 1) 0 = l.getD i 0 := by
  simp [List.getD]

lemma getD_drop' : ∀ (k : Nat) (l : List Nat) (j : Nat),
    (l.drop k).getD j 0 = l.getD (k + j) 0 := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro l j; simp
  | succ k ih =>
    intro l j
    cases l with
    | nil => simp [List.getD]
    | cons a t =>
      have h : k + 1 + j = (k + j) + 1 := by omega
      rw [List.drop_succ_cons, ih t j, h, getD_cons_succ']

@[simp] lemma total_loot_nil (values : List Nat) : total_loot [] values = 0 := by
  simp [total_loot]

lemma foldl_loot (values : List Nat) : ∀ (houses : List Nat) (a : Nat),
    houses.foldl (fun acc i => acc + values.getD i 0) a
      = a + houses.foldl (fun acc i => acc + values.getD i 0) 0 := by
  intro houses
  induction houses with
  | nil => intro a; simp
  | cons h t ih =>
    intro a
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    rw [ih (a + values.getD h 0), ih (0 + values.getD h 0)]
    omega

lemma total_loot_cons (values : List Nat) (h : Nat) (t : List Nat) :
    total_loot (h :: t) values = values.getD h 0 + total_loot t values := by
  unfold total_loot
  simp only [List.foldl_cons]
  rw [foldl_loot values t (0 + values.getD h 0)]
  omega

lemma total_loot_map_add (k : Nat) (nums : List Nat) : ∀ (l : List Nat),
    total_loot (l.map (· + k)) nums = total_loot l (nums.drop k) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, total_loot_cons, ih, getD_drop']
    rw [Nat.add_comm k a]

lemma total_loot_map_sub (k : Nat) (nums : List Nat) : ∀ (l : List Nat),
    (∀ x ∈ l, k ≤ x) → total_loot l nums = total_loot (l.map (· - k)) (nums.drop k) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro hk
    have hka : k ≤ a := hk a (by simp)
    simp only [List.map_cons, total_loot_cons, getD_drop']
    rw [ih (fun z hz => hk z (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hz))]
    have hidx : k + (a - k) = a := by omega
    rw [hidx]

lemma nonAdj_head {a b : Nat} {t : List Nat} (h : NonAdj (a :: b :: t)) : a + 2 ≤ b := by
  cases h
  assumption

lemma nonAdj_tail {a : Nat} {t : List Nat} (h : NonAdj (a :: t)) : NonAdj t := by
  cases t with
  | nil => exact NonAdj.nil
  | cons b t' =>
    cases h
    assumption

lemma nonAdj_head_le : ∀ (t : List Nat) (a : Nat), NonAdj (a :: t) → ∀ z ∈ t, a + 2 ≤ z := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | nil => intro a _ z hz; simp at hz
  | cons b t' ih =>
    intro a h z hz
    have h1 : a + 2 ≤ b := nonAdj_head h
    have h2 : NonAdj (b :: t') := nonAdj_tail h
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl | hz'
    · exact h1
    · have h3 := ih b h2 z hz'
      omega

lemma nonAdj_map (f : Nat → Nat) : ∀ (l : List Nat), NonAdj l →
    (∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b ∈ l, a + 2 ≤ b → f a + 2 ≤ f b) → NonAdj (l.map f) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro _ _
    simp only [List.map_nil]
    exact NonAdj.nil
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro hch hf
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
      exact NonAdj.one (f a)
    | cons b t' =>
      have h1 : a + 2 ≤ b := nonAdj_head hch
      have h2 : NonAdj (b :: t') := nonAdj_tail hch
      have hrest : NonAdj ((b :: t').map f) :=
        ih h2 (fun p hp q hq hpq =>
          hf p (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hp) q (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hq) hpq)
      simp only [List.map_cons] at hrest ⊢
      exact NonAdj.cons (f a) (f b) (t'.map f) (hf a (by simp) b (by simp) h1) hrest

lemma nonAdj_zero_cons_map : ∀ (l : List Nat), NonAdj l → NonAdj (0 :: l.map (· + 2)) := by
  intro l h
  cases l with
  | nil =>
    simp only [List.map_nil]
    exact NonAdj.one 0
  | cons w ws =>
    have hmap : NonAdj ((w :: ws).map (· + 2)) := by
      refine nonAdj_map (· + 2) (w :: ws) h ?_
      intro a _ b _ hab
      show a + 2 + 2 ≤ b + 2
      omega
    simp only [List.map_cons] at hmap ⊢
    exact NonAdj.cons 0 (w + 2) (ws.map (· + 2)) (by omega) hmap

lemma mem_of_getD (n : Nat) : ∀ (l : List Nat),
    (∀ i, i < l.length → l.getD i 0 < n) → ∀ x ∈ l, x < n := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ x hx; simp at hx
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro h x hx
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
    · have h0 := h 0 (by simp)
      rw [getD_cons_zero'] at h0
      exact h0
    · refine ih (fun i hi => ?_) x hx'
      have h1 := h (i + 1) (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
      rw [getD_cons_succ'] at h1
      exact h1

lemma getD_of_mem (n : Nat) : ∀ (l : List Nat),
    (∀ x ∈ l, x < n) → ∀ i, i < l.length → l.getD i 0 < n := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ i hi; simp only [List.length_nil] at hi; omega
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro h i hi
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      rw [getD_cons_zero']
      exact h a (by simp)
    | succ j =>
      rw [getD_cons_succ']
      refine ih (fun z hz => h z (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hz)) j ?_
      simp only [List.length_cons] at hi
      omega

lemma nonAdj_of_getD : ∀ (l : List Nat),
    (∀ i, i < l.length - 1 → l.getD (i+1) 0 ≥ l.getD i 0 + 2) → NonAdj l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _; exact NonAdj.nil
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro h
    cases t with
    | nil => exact NonAdj.one a
    | cons b t' =>
      refine NonAdj.cons a b t' ?_ (ih ?_)
      · have h0 := h 0 (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
        rw [getD_cons_succ' a (b :: t') 0, getD_cons_zero' b t',
          getD_cons_zero' a (b :: t')] at h0
        exact h0
      · intro i hi
        have h1 := h (i + 1) (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega)
        rw [getD_cons_succ' a (b :: t') (i + 1), getD_cons_succ' a (b :: t') i] at h1
        exact h1

lemma getD_of_nonAdj : ∀ (l : List Nat), NonAdj l →
    ∀ i, i < l.length - 1 → l.getD (i+1) 0 ≥ l.getD i 0 + 2 := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro _ i hi
    simp only [List.length_nil] at hi
    omega
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro h i hi
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hi
      omega
    | cons b t' =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
        rw [getD_cons_succ' a (b :: t') 0, getD_cons_zero' b t',
          getD_cons_zero' a (b :: t')]
        exact nonAdj_head h

        refine ih (nonAdj_tail h) j ?_
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢
        omega

    have hnil : nums = [] := by

      | nil => rfl

    subst hnil
    have hh : houses = [] := by

      | nil => rfl
      | cons a t =>

    rcases nums with _ | ⟨v, tl⟩
    · have hh : houses = [] := by

        | nil => rfl
        | cons a t =>

          simp only [List.length_nil] at h
          exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero a)

      simp [robList]

        | nil => simp [robList]
        | cons hh tt =>

            have h := hmem hh (by simp)
            simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at h

            have hz : hh = 0 := by omega
            subst hz
            rw [total_loot_cons, getD_cons_zero']
            simp [robList]
          | cons b t' =>

            omega
      · -- nums = v :: w :: rest
        have hn' : rest.length + 1 + 1 ≤ n + 1 := by
          simpa only [List.length_cons] using hn
        have hlen1 : rest.length ≤ n := by omega
        have hlen2 : (w :: rest).length ≤ n := by
          simp only [List.length_cons]; omega
        cases houses with
        | nil => simp
        | cons hh tt =>
          by_cases hz : hh = 0
          · subst hz

              intro z hz'

    (∀ x ∈ robSet nums, x < nums.length) ∧

    · simp [robSet]
    · simp only [robSet]

          · rw [hrs, total_loot_cons, total_loot_map_add, getD_cons_zero']
            have hdrop : (v :: w :: rest).drop 2 = rest := by simp
            rw [hdrop, t1]
            simp only [robList]
            exact (max_eq_left hif).symm
        · have hrs : robSet (v :: w :: rest) = (robSet (w :: rest)).map (· + 1) := by
            simp [robSet, hif]
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [hrs]
            intro z hz
            simp only [List.mem_map] at hz
            obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hz
            have h := m2 u hu
            simp only [List.length_cons] at h ⊢
            omega

            show a + 1 + 2 ≤ b + 1
            omega
          · rw [hrs, total_loot_map_add]
            have hdrop : (v :: w :: rest).drop 1 = w :: rest := by simp
            rw [hdrop, t2]
            simp only [robList]
            have hle' : v + robList rest ≤ robList (w :: rest) := by omega
            exact (max_eq_right hle').symm

    rob_postcond nums (rob nums h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof

    rw [hseq]
